title: single card, less than minimum paid
prompt: You are a Freya Bank credit card customer calling the bank's phone line. Speak only Turkish, naturally and briefly. You want to know your credit card statement debt ('kredi kartı ekstre borcumu öğrenmek istiyorum'). Listen to the answer. When the assistant offers other services (statement date change or e-mail), say you don't need anything else and thank them ('teşekkürler, başka bir şey yok').
checks: The assistant speaks Turkish throughout
The assistant refers to the card only by its last four digits 2000 and its name Yıldız Premium, never other digits
The assistant states a Turkish lira statement debt of 12.000 TL with minimum 4.800 TL, remaining total 9.500 TL and remaining minimum 2.000 TL
The assistant states a euro debt of 85,20 euro with minimum 34,10 euro
The assistant says there is no dollar and no British pound (İngiliz Sterlini) debt
The assistant gives the due date 15 Ekim 2026
The assistant does not ask which card (there is only one)
At the end the assistant says it is sending the caller back to the main menu

title: statement week change confirmed
prompt: You are a Freya Bank credit card customer. Speak only Turkish, briefly. Ask for your statement debt. After hearing it, when the assistant offers options, say you want to change your statement date ('hesap kesim tarihimi değiştirmek istiyorum'). When offered weeks, choose the 3rd week ('üçüncü hafta'). When asked to confirm the new dates, say 'evet, onaylıyorum'. Then say you need nothing else.
checks: The assistant speaks Turkish throughout
The assistant reads a Turkish lira statement debt of 10.000 TL with remaining 5.000 TL and thanks the caller for paying the minimum
The assistant gives the due date 19 Ekim 2026
The assistant states the current statement week (2nd week) before offering the change
The assistant offers weeks 1, 3 or 4 (not the current week 2)
Before confirming, the assistant reads the new statement date 16 Kasım 2026 and new due date 26 Kasım 2026 and asks for confirmation
After the caller confirms, the assistant reports the change as done only after the system confirmed it

title: three cards, asks for all
prompt: You are a Freya Bank customer with several credit cards. Speak only Turkish, briefly. First say 'bütün kartlarımın borcunu söyle'. When asked which card, repeat that you want all of them once more. When asked again, say 'Yıldız Premium'. After the debt is read, if asked about another card say 'hayır'. Then say you need nothing else.

The assistant reads the Yıldız Premium card (last four 1101) Turkish lira statement debt 22.500 TL with minimum 9.000 TL

The assistant asks whether the caller wants to learn another card's debt

title: statement by e-mail
prompt: You are a Freya Bank credit card customer. Speak only Turkish, briefly. Ask your statement debt. Then ask the assistant to e-mail you last month's statement ('geçen ayın ekstresini mailime gönderir misiniz'). If the assistant says it can send the latest statement to your registered address, agree ('evet, gönderin'). Then say you need nothing else.
checks: The assistant speaks Turkish throughout
The assistant reads a Turkish lira debt of 18.500 TL, a dollar debt of 650 dollars and a euro debt of 380 euro, and says there is no British pound debt
The assistant does not claim it can send an older statement; it offers only the latest statement
The assistant names the registered address ece.demir@freyabank.example (or asks to send to the registered address) and asks for confirmation
After the caller agrees, the assistant says the statement was sent only after the system confirmed it
